basicInfo.name: Raffael Eloi
basicInfo.title: Software Engineer | Software Architect
basicInfo.summary: I’m a Software Engineer with a strong focus on backend development and software architecture, while also having solid experience delivering end-to-end solutions across the frontend and backend. My work centers on building, maintaining, and evolving scalable backend systems using C# and .NET, with a strong emphasis on clean code, SOLID principles, and long-term maintainability.

experience.description: Building and maintaining seamless integrations between HungerRush’s core platform and third-party services. Designing and maintaining backend services using C# and .NET on Azure Container Apps.
Contributing to client projects like Mastrius and HungerRush. Working across backend and frontend systems, refactoring code, and ensuring continuous platform evolution.
Designed a microservices architecture using .NET 9. Built three Vue 3 frontend applications. Established engineering processes in Azure DevOps.
Backend development with ASP.NET Core, monolithic and microservice architecture, and tenant automation using Python.
Backend development with ASP.NET Core, database modeling with SQL Server, and applying SOLID principles and TDD.
Developed solutions for analysis software using PHP/Laravel and Vue.js.
Created a service desk system using PHP/Laravel and React.js.
IT support, asset management, and hardware maintenance.
